text:
Evan (PM): quick sync on response-shape launch gating — need final decision on validation vs best-effort repair.

Maya (Eng): +1. Goal: reduce customer breakage at launch but allow rollout for non-critical customers.

Rohan (ML): proposal: v1 = strict schema validation with automatic single-retry using model-temperature lower + schema-augmented prompt; v2 = probabilistic repair / patcher + explainability.

Priya (SWE): SDK changes needed: add response_mode: "shape" and retry_policy per-request. Also expose validation errors in response metadata.

Lena (CS): support asked for by big customer (FinCo) — they require field-level presence and types, want automatic retries disabled initially.

Evan (PM): So options: A) strict-gate: fail fast + no fallback (good for regulated customers) B) soft-gate: return best-effort, tag errors + background repair C) hybrid: per-route policy with default soft-gate. Thoughts?

Maya (Eng): Hybrid seems highest impact with lowest risk. Default soft-gate for self-serve; enterprise routes can opt strict.

Rohan (ML): For retry heuristic: if schema failure is "missing_field" or "wrong_type" then do 1 retry with deterministic decoding (temp=0) + schema-augmented prompt. Show pseudocode:

```
if validate(resp, schema) == False:
  if attempts < 1:
    call_model(prompt + "output must match schema: ...", temp=0)
```

Priya (SWE): we should also add server-side metrics: validation_failure_rate, post_retry_success_rate, average extra latency.

Lena (CS): For FinCo we need audit logs of validation errors + original and repaired outputs.

Evan (PM): Launch criteria v1 (canary): validation_failure_rate < 5% on synthetic tests; post_retry_success_rate > 60%; SDK flag + console toggle for strict vs soft; docs + migration guide. Timeline: 2 weeks for prototype canary.

Maya (Eng): Assignments: Maya -> prototype validator + API toggle; Rohan -> retry heuristics + prompt templates; Priya -> SDK + telemetry hooks; Lena -> customer migration doc; Evan -> coordinate canary and announce to customers.

qa-bot: nightly test added: schema-smoke-suite run on canary cluster @ 03:00 UTC

Priya (SWE): one more: what's behavior for tool-calling endpoints? If tool output is used to satisfy schema we may need tool-level validation and retries too.

Rohan (ML): agree — treat tool outputs as inputs to validation. Retry flow should allow re-invocation of tool up to 1 extra attempt.

Evan (PM): ok let's lock hybrid default soft-gate, enterprise opt-in strict, 1 auto-retry with temp=0, per-route toggle + telemetry. Meeting follow-up RFC in #product-rfcs by EOD Thursday. :thumbsup: 

Maya (Eng): i'll open RFC and attach minimal api spec snippet.

Priya (SWE): will add SDK flag PR and informal release note.

Lena (CS): I'll sync with FinCo legal on audit log format.

Evan (PM): thanks all. closing thread — will post RFC link in here once created.
